info.name: JFrog Release Lifecycle Management REST API
info.description:
API for managing release bundles, promotion workflows, and evidence collection throughout the software release lifecycle from development to production. Provides capabilities for creating immutable release bundles, promoting them through environments, and collecting attestation evidence.

Contact Support:
 Name: JFrog
